Suspicion requires any of: (1) invoice value inconsistent with the described goods or market rate; (2) shipping documents that do not correspond to the routing claimed; (3) repeat amendments that alter beneficiary or value late in the cycle. Absent a matching typology, the general unusual-activity standard applies. The typology-assessment agent scores each indicator MET / NOT_MET / INSUFFICIENT against the activity evidence.
